# Hoidio

> Hoidio is a medication reminder app (pill reminder and medication list) for seniors and older adults, and for the family members who care for them. It was designed by a pharmacist in Finland and is made by HLC-International (Espoo, Finland). Hoidio is available for Android on Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hoidio.app) and is coming soon for iPhone, in Finnish, Swedish, English and Arabic.

Key facts:

- Free for the person whose medicines it tracks: all of their own features, any number of medicines, and inviting caregivers. No ads.
- The person keeps their medicines, dose times, refills, doctor visits, measurements, side effects and emergency information in one place, and gets a reminder at every dose time.
- Family caregivers use the Hoidio Family plan to follow a person: see the medicine schedule, doses taken and the daily "I'm OK" check-in, and can get an alert if a reminder isn't confirmed or the check-in isn't answered. It also gives daily, weekly or monthly summaries, and the full health record when the person allows it.
- Hoidio Family costs €4.99 per month or €49.99 per year (VAT included), with a 14-day free trial. One plan covers up to 2 people followed and up to 3 caregivers; only one caregiver pays. It is bought in the app through the App Store or Google Play.
- Data is stored in the EU (Frankfurt), is never sold, and there is no tracking. Users must be 18 or over.
- Hoidio organizes information and reminds. It does not diagnose, treat or give medical advice, and it does not replace a doctor or pharmacist.
